parameters.content:
## 01 Receive + build card
TCMS's flow2Notify.ts posts here after a
genuinely-new RISK_REVIEW_PROPOSED case
(never on an idempotent-replay attach).

## 02 Post to Teams
TeamId/channelId and the Teams OAuth2
credential are placeholders -- pick them
live in the n8n UI (same reset-on-restart
gotcha as Flow 0's mail folder ID; see
HANDOVER_FLOW2.md). Uses the same "Tax CMS"
Azure AD app as Flow 0, with Teams Graph
permissions added.

## 03 Respond to TCMS
TCMS's notifyFlow2ReviewCase() already
treats a non-2xx/timeout as best-effort
(logged, never fails the ingestion
response) -- this branch exists so a Teams
outage is still visible in n8n's own
execution log, not just swallowed twice.

## VERSION INFO
Workflow: DigiTax | Invoice Phase 1 | Flow 2 | Teams Review Notify | v0.1.0
Status: draft, INACTIVE by default -- needs a live Teams credential +
teamId/channelId picked in the n8n UI, and Teams Graph permissions
(ChannelMessage.Send at minimum) added to whichever Azure AD app your
Outlook/Flow 0 credential already uses (reuse it, do not register a new
one) before activating.
Trigger: TCMS's flow2Notify.ts (server/utils/n8n/flow2Notify.ts), called
from all three ingestion routes (n8n-inbound-runs, n8n-batch-item-runs,
n8n-flow1b-runs) exactly once per genuinely-new RISK_REVIEW_PROPOSED
ReviewCase. Option A design (HANDOVER_FLOW2.md): notify + deep link only --
this workflow never calls TCMS's decision endpoint itself; the human
clicks through and decides inside TCMS's own session-authenticated UI.
